_files: THE PRINT MASTERS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT IN THIS REPO. 'All posters final.pdf' is 102 MB, which GitHub rejects outright, and 'cover print pdf.pdf' is 30 MB — both are print-production artefacts whose content is already on the site as the individual poster JPEGs in Stories. What is committed is the reading copy of each publication and nothing else. Sizes are read off disk at build time, never typed here, so a figure on the page cannot drift from the file it describes.

masthead.lead: Not a catalogue. One book about a neighbourhood we worked in for years, one guide written to be carried into a shop, and one piece of research — the only primary research the organisation has published. All three open whole, free, with no address asked for.

frame.alt: India Gate at dusk, its lamps lit under a hazy sky

items.head: The publications
items.lead: Each one is the reading copy. Nothing is behind a form, and nothing asks who you are.

entries.title: Khirki Extension, Delhi
entries.lead: A record of one Delhi neighbourhood — its water, its waste, its building, and the people who explained all three to us. Made over the years Swechha worked there, and printed rather than posted because the people in it wanted something they could hold.

entries.title: The Sustainable Shopping Basket
entries.lead: A lifestyle and shopping guide, made with GIZ. Written to answer the question that follows every talk about consumption — what do I actually buy instead — and short enough to be read in a queue.

entries.title: Future Lifestyles: the New Delhi scenario
entries.credit: Published by IGES. Swechha was the New Delhi partner.
entries.lead: A low-carbon-lifestyles scenario for New Delhi in 2030, built with the Institute for Global Environmental Strategies as one city in a multi-city series. It is the only primary research on this site, and the only document here Swechha did not publish itself.

waiting.head: What is not here
waiting.lead: Recorded so that nobody looks twice.
claims: The This Girl Can book was asked for and then withdrawn. No book file was found for it either — what exists is a poster series and a set of photographs, and neither is a publication.
The GIZ marine-plastic infographics exist and are not on this page. They belong with the campaign they were made for, and that campaign does not have a page yet.

act.head: Print with us
act.lead: Both of these were made because somebody paid for the printing.

_rights: THE IGES REPORT IS NOT SWECHHA'S PUBLICATION. IGES published it; Swechha co-authored the New Delhi chapter. It is hosted here on the owner's instruction of 22 August, and the page credits IGES as publisher and links to them. If IGES would rather it were linked than re-hosted, the fix is to delete the file and turn the button into a link — the entry already carries credit_url for exactly that. Worth confirming with them; the instruction was given knowing this.
